title: Friday Night Open Go (Weiqi / Baduk) & Match Play
venue: Seattle Go Center (6532 Phinney Ave N)
description: Casual match play for players of all ranks (30 kyu to 7 dan). Novices welcome; volunteers provide free beginner lessons on rules, liberties, and eye space.
cost: $5 non-member day pass, free for members

title: Cougar Mountain Trail Run (Saturday Morning Series)
venue: Red Town Trailhead, Cougar Mountain Regional Wildland Park
description: Group trail run through forested trails of Cougar Mountain. Multiple pace groups from 9 to 13 min/mile with regrouping at major junctions. Beginner trail runners welcome.

title: Saturday Morning Green Lake Run & Walk
venue: Green Lake Community Center (Archway by courts)
description: Weekly Saturday morning 5K / 3-mile loop run and walk around Green Lake for LGBTQ+ community members and allies, followed by coffee and brunch at a nearby cafe.

title: Lake Union Dragon Boat Morning Training
venue: Kenmore Air Harbor Dock, South Lake Union
description: Open team practice for new and experienced dragon boat paddlers. All equipment (paddles and life vests) provided. Great full-body team workout on Lake Union.

title: Saturday Lake Washington Loop Community Bike Ride
venue: Log Boom Park, Kenmore (start) to Lake Washington Blvd
description: Steady pace (12-14 mph) 28-mile social group ride along the Burke-Gilman Trail and Lake Washington loop. Regrouping at hill crests; no rider left behind.

title: Green Lake Open Kayak & Canoe Morning Paddle
venue: Green Lake Small Craft Center (5900 W Green Lake Way N)
description: Structured sprint canoe and kayak practice session on Green Lake. Focus on stroke technique, boat balance, and aerobic conditioning.
cost: Free for members, guest pass available

title: Discovery Park Fall Bird Migration Walk
venue: Discovery Park Visitor Center (3801 Discovery Park Blvd)
description: Join volunteer naturalists searching for fall songbird migrants, raptors, and coastal seabirds along the forest loop and bluff trails. Binoculars available for loan.

title: Sunday Public Sail & Classic Wooden Boat Rides
venue: South Lake Union, 1010 Valley St, Seattle
description: Free community public sailboat rides on Lake Union aboard historic wooden boats skippered by volunteer captains. In-person sign-ups begin at 10 AM at the floating livery.

title: Sunday Co-Ed Ultimate Frisbee Hat Scrimmage & Clinic
venue: Jefferson Park Turf Field, Beacon Hill
description: Open hat scrimmage and throwing mechanics clinic for recreational and intermediate ultimate players before the fall league season begins.

title: Monday Evening Silent Reading & Social Hour
venue: C&P Coffee Company, West Seattle (5612 California Ave SW)
description: No assigned reading, no homework! Arrive, grab a drink, settle in for an uninterrupted hour of companionable silent reading, followed by optional book chatting.

title: Monday Night Roller Derby Fundamentals & Scrimmage
venue: Magnuson Park Hangar 30 (7400 Sand Point Way NE)
description: Recreational roller derby practice focusing on stops, agility footwork, pack positioning, and non-contact drills. Quad skates and full protective pads required.

title: Tuesday Night Track Workout & Intervals
venue: West Seattle Stadium Track
description: Coach-led interval training session for distance and cross-country runners. Warm-up, structured tempo/interval set, and cooldown. All paces welcome.

title: Tuesday Evening Rated Tournament & Open Board Play
venue: Seattle Go Center (6532 Phinney Ave N)
description: AGA handicap tournament games and casual untimed review sessions with national-rated players.

title: Wednesday Community Open Hacknight & 3D Print Lab
venue: Seattle Makers Lab (South Lake Union)
description: Bring your personal tinkering projects! Tour laser cutters, CNC routers, and 3D printers. Meet maker mentors and collaborate with other DIY creators.

title: Wednesday Evening Volunteer Park Run
venue: Volunteer Park Reservoir (meet by Water Tower)
description: Scenic mid-week evening run through Capitol Hill and Volunteer Park trails, followed by post-run social.

title: First Thursday Resident Artist Open Studios & Clay Demo
venue: Pottery Northwest Studio (Pioneer Square)
description: Explore ceramic works in progress, meet resident ceramicists, and watch live wheel throwing demonstrations during Pioneer Square First Thursday Art Walk.

title: Magnuson Park Climbing Wall Social & Gear Night
venue: Seattle Program Center (7700 Sand Point Way NE)
description: Open community climbing night on the indoor wall and outdoor climbing rock. Connect with belay partners, review rope rigging, and learn about upcoming alpine courses.
cost: Free for members, guest pass available

title: First Friday Outdoor Community Mixer & Gear Swap
venue: Gearhouse Seattle Clubhouse (Capitol Hill / SLU)
description: Casual monthly social for backpackers, skiers, and trail runners. Chat about trip itineraries, check out gear rentals, and meet trip partners for the upcoming weekend.

title: Pacific Northwest Filmmakers Showcase & Reception
venue: Northwest Film Forum (1515 12th Ave, Capitol Hill)
description: Curated evening of new short films produced by Washington independent directors, followed by an in-person filmmaker panel and courtyard reception.

title: Friday Blitz & Casual Rapid Chess Night
venue: Northgate Community Center (Seattle Chess Club Room)
description: Weekly blitz tournaments (G/5) and open casual play. Clocks and boards provided. Spectators and drop-in players welcome.
cost: Free for members, small drop-in fee

title: Elliott Bay & Alki Point Sea Kayak Day Tour
venue: Don Armeni Boat Ramp, West Seattle
description: Guided open water sea kayak excursion along the West Seattle waterfront and Alki Lighthouse. SKII rating, wet exit and self-rescue skills required.

title: Saturday Fixit Clinic & Community Repair Cafe
venue: Capitol Hill Tool Library (basement of 1520 10th Ave)
description: Bring your broken household appliances, lamps, bikes, and garments. Volunteer fixers help you diagnose and repair them for free while teaching DIY maintenance skills.

title: Saturday Learn to Curl & Drop-In Ice Clinic
venue: Granite Curling Club (1440 N 128th St, Seattle)
description: Experience curling on dedicated ice! 2-hour lesson covering sliding, sweeping, stone delivery, and strategy, followed by a mini-game. Grippers and brooms provided.

title: Duthie Hill Mountain Bike Trail Work Party
venue: Duthie Hill Mountain Bike Park (Issaquah/Sammamish)
description: Reshape berms, repair jump lips, and clean drainage channels on the Pacific Northwest premier progressive mountain bike trail network.

title: Magnuson Park Native Plant & Wetland Walk
organization: Washington Native Plant Society (Central Puget Sound)
venue: Warren G. Magnuson Park (Wetlands parking lot)
description: Educational walking tour of restored wetlands and native shrub communities led by botanists from the Central Puget Sound chapter. Learn to identify local willows, sedges, and berries.

title: Sunday Adult Co-Ed 7v7 Soccer Tournament
venue: Starfire Sports Complex (Field 1 & 2), Tukwila
description: One-day round-robin co-ed tournament on outdoor turf fields at the Pacific Northwest soccer headquarters. 3 guaranteed games, certified referees.

title: Monday Night Pinball League Tournament Meet
venue: Shorty's (Belltown) / Add-a-Ball (Fremont)
description: Bi-weekly competitive match play across classic and modern pinball machines. IFPA world ranking points awarded.

title: Wednesday Evening Food Sorting & Packing Shift
venue: Northwest Harvest Warehouse Distribution Center (Kent)
description: High-energy volunteer shift packing bulk produce, dry beans, and pantry staples into family-sized packages for food banks across Washington State.

title: Community Bio-Tinkering & PCR DNA Extraction Lab
venue: SoundBio Lab (1100 NE 47th St, University District)
description: Hands-on molecular biology workshop for citizen scientists and curious community members. Learn pipetting, gel electrophoresis, and explore biotechnology projects.

title: Community Affordable Housing Build Day
organization: Habitat for Humanity King County Construction Volunteers
venue: Habitat KC Build Site (Renton / Tukwila)
description: Join a construction team framing walls, installing siding, and building sustainable affordable housing for local King County families. Tools and safety training provided.

title: Lincoln Park Forest Restoration Work Party
venue: Lincoln Park, West Seattle (meet at Kiosk by south lot)
description: Join volunteer park stewards removing invasive English ivy and planting Pacific Northwest conifers and ferns to restore urban forest canopy.

title: Community Pruning & Tree Care Hands-On Workshop
venue: PlantAmnesty Demonstration Garden, Seattle
description: Master proper structural pruning techniques for fruit trees and deciduous ornamentals. Taught by certified arborists dedicated to ending improper tree shearing and topping.

title: South King Tool Library Volunteer Tool Sharpening & Repair Fair
venue: South King Tool Library (1700 S 340th St, Federal Way)
description: Community repair fair and garden tool sharpening clinic. Sharpen mower blades, pruners, and axes. Learn how to borrow tools for free from the community catalog.

title: Green Lake Public Telescope Star Party
venue: Green Lake Park (Northwest Lawn by bathhouse theater)
description: Volunteer astronomers set up high-powered telescopes for the public to view the Moon, Saturn rings, and bright star clusters. Free and family-friendly (weather permitting).

title: Tiger Mountain Volunteer Trail Maintenance Day
venue: High Point Trailhead, Tiger Mountain State Forest
description: Spend the day in the woods clearing drainage dips, brushing overgrown salal, and rebuilding tread along one of Issaquah Alps most popular trails. No experience needed.

title: October General Meeting & Mushroom ID Clinic
venue: Center for Urban Horticulture (CUH), 3501 NE 41st St
description: Peak fall mushroom season meeting! Bring fresh specimens for identification by expert mycologists at the ID table starting at 6:30 PM, followed by the featured lecture.
cost: Free and open to the public

title: Community Work Party & Harvest Celebration
venue: Beacon Hill Food Forest (15th Ave S & S Dakota St)
description: Third Saturday work party! Help weed, mulch orchard guild beds, plant winter cover crops, and share a community potluck lunch at 1 PM. Gloves and tools provided.

title: Community Glassblowing & Metal Sculpture Open House
venue: Pratt Fine Arts Center (1902 S Main St, Central District)
description: Live glassblowing and hot metal casting demonstrations in Pratt open-air studios. Chat with instructors about upcoming classes in woodworking, jewelry, and printmaking.

title: October Sunday Sketch Outing: Pioneer Square Historic District
venue: Occidental Square Park (Pioneer Square Pergola)
description: Monthly sketch crawl on location! Bring sketchbooks, pens, or watercolors. Gather at 10 AM, sketch the historic brick architecture, and regroup at 12:15 PM for the sketchbook throwdown.

title: Monthly Meeting & Fall Cutthroat Fly Tying Workshop
venue: Seattle Community Center / Mercer Island VFW Post
description: Guest lecture on Puget Sound sea-run cutthroat trout conservation followed by hands-on fly-tying table demonstrations and member fishing reports.

title: Cedar River & South Lake Washington Open Community Row
venue: Renton Rowing Center Boathouse (10 Sunset Blvd N, Renton)
description: Master and recreational rowing session along the mouth of Cedar River and South Lake Washington. Sculling and sweep boats available for experienced rowers.
cost: Member session / Visitor day pass available

title: Docent-Led Aviation History & Restoration Tour
venue: Museum of Flight (9404 E Marginal Way S, Tukwila)
description: Deep-dive guided walking tour led by veteran docents covering Pacific Northwest aviation pioneers, WWII aircraft, and the space gallery.

title: Good Shepherd Center Fall Soil Prep & Garlic Planting
venue: Tilth Alliance Demonstration Garden (4649 Sunnyside Ave N, Wallingford)
description: Hands-on organic gardening work party. Learn techniques for winter cover cropping, sheet mulching, composting, and planting hardneck garlic cloves.

title: Kubota Garden Fall Color Stewardship Work Party
venue: Kubota Garden (9817 55th Ave S, Seattle)
description: Help care for historic Japanese garden landscape ponds and specimen maples during peak autumn foliage in South Seattle.
